objectIdentity.intentionalCompositionPreserved: SoftwareDescriptor and CatalogSoftwareMetadata profiles on one software object; multiple recipe references to that object

entryActions.boundary: recipes attached to each catalog entry

required.vps: explicit unqualified legacy install recipe, never qualified implicitly

entryActions.supplementaryRecipes: Configure-only recipes are valid when another eligible attached recipe supplies installation. Unattached recipes do not count.
entryActions.resolution: Prefer a qualified matching recipe automatically; explicit unqualified recipe selections remain blocked.
entryActions.removedPermissions: Missing actions are not restored; explicitly withdrawing the mode is accepted.

regressionCoverage: Failed fresh packages publish generation zero, no content objects, commits or private documents.
Invalid updates retain the entire prior repository state, active catalog digest, ordinary local objects and object history.
Matching labels cannot hide a software/recipe identity collision.
Multiple recipes can share software and intentional profile composition; configure-only supplement remains configure-only.
An unqualified recipe cannot shadow qualified coverage or qualify itself through a different explicit selection.
Unattached recipes cannot authorize an advertised mode; mode withdrawal preserves prior recipe history.
Default 18 authored objects match independently validated stored profiles/RDF; software labels and all six membership modes agree.
Stable identities/defaults, Devgraph connect-only, unqualified Matrix VPS and repeat-import no-op behavior remain intact.
limits: Qualification is fixture-only for this validation change; no new production build or live UI/HTTP qualification was performed.
Valid existing packages retain their shapes/defaults. Previously accepted malformed packages now reject; automatic repair of an already malformed stored snapshot is not implemented.
Remote retrieval, new ontology types, additional stores/executors and publisher trust expansion remain out of scope.
